views.name: customer_labels
views.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.total_amount, p.segment AS segment FROM customer_totals c JOIN customer_profiles p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id

views.name: customer_profiles
views.sql: SELECT customer_id, segment, region FROM profiles_raw

views.name: customer_totals
views.sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(order_id) AS paid_count FROM paid_orders GROUP BY customer_id

views.name: high_value_customers
views.sql: SELECT customer_id, total_amount FROM customer_totals WHERE total_amount >= 100

views.name: net_orders
views.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.amount - a.adjustment_amount AS net_amount FROM paid_orders o JOIN order_adjustments a ON o.order_id = a.order_id

views.name: order_adjustments
views.sql: SELECT a.order_id, SUM(a.amount) AS adjustment_amount FROM adjustments_raw a GROUP BY a.order_id

views.name: paid_orders
views.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, amount, created_at, channel FROM raw_orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'settled')

views.name: raw_orders
views.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, amount, status, created_at, channel FROM orders_raw
